key_fields.name: WS-US-PHONE-AREA-CODE-TO-EDIT
key_fields.meaning: 3-character area code to look up; carries the three area-code 88-level lists.

key_fields.name: VALID-PHONE-AREA-CODE
key_fields.meaning: All North American area codes in the list (general purpose plus easily recognizable codes), 490 values from the NANPA report cited in the comment; not used by COACTUPC.

key_fields.name: VALID-GENERAL-PURP-CODE
key_fields.meaning: 410 general-purpose area codes; the list COACTUPC checks for phone numbers.

key_fields.name: VALID-EASY-RECOG-AREA-CODE
key_fields.meaning: 80 easily recognizable codes (repeating-digit patterns such as 200, 211, 222 ... 999); not used by COACTUPC.

key_fields.name: VALID-US-STATE-CODE
key_fields.meaning: 56 upper-case codes: the 50 states, DC, and territories AS, GU, MP, PR, VI.

key_fields.name: US-STATE-AND-FIRST-ZIP2
key_fields.meaning: State code followed by the first two zip digits.

key_fields.name: VALID-US-STATE-ZIP-CD2-COMBO
key_fields.meaning: 240 valid state + zip-prefix combinations (for example 'AK99', 'WY83'), including military codes AA and AE.

key_fields.name: LAST-3-OF-ZIP
key_fields.meaning: Remaining 3 zip characters; not referenced by COACTUPC.

observations.text: Combinations for military codes AA and AE (and others outside the state list) can never match in COACTUPC, because the state must first pass VALID-US-STATE-CODE, which does not contain AA or AE (Inferred).

Area-code lists are static literals taken from the NANPA report (https://nationalnanpa.com/nanp1/npa_report.csv per the comment); new area codes need a source change and recompile of every program copying the member.
The comment 'Search list of valid Phone area codes' sits above the state code list, not the area-code lists.
Value lines are indented with tab characters rather than fixed-column spaces.

purpose: Lookup-table copybook of three 01-level edit fields whose 88-level VALUE lists hold reference data: North American telephone area codes (all, general purpose, and easily recognizable), US state and territory codes, and valid state + first-two-zip-digit combinations. A program moves a value into the edit field and tests the 88-level. Only COACTUPC copies it, using VALID-GENERAL-PURP-CODE for phone area codes, VALID-US-STATE-CODE for the customer state and VALID-US-STATE-ZIP-CD2-COMBO for the state/zip cross edit.
